NGO Training Attendance and Stipend Tracker

Training projects need clean participant lists, attendance, session proof, stipend status, and donor reports.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 25,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 1,500Recommended monthly charge

BDT 1,500/month plus setup is possible because NGOs value reporting and compliance.

6.6Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 25,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 1,500Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 8,600,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target NGOs, training providers, donor-funded projects, youth skills centers, and field programs that need attendance, photo proof, and reporting.

Field teams collect paper attendance and later struggle to prepare reports.

Training attendance and report proof become ready without paper chaos.

Validation signals

  • Bangladesh has many skills and NGO programs.
  • Attendance proof is recurring.
  • Reporting has direct value.
  • Project budgets can pay higher setup.

MVP modules

  • Participant profile
  • Batch/session
  • Attendance
  • Photo proof
  • Stipend status
  • Trainer note
  • Export report

Do not build first

  • Do not handle stipend money custody.
  • Do not fake attendance.
  • Do not overbuild donor portal.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Procurement cycle.
  • Custom donor formats.
  • Field connectivity.
Mitigations

  • Configurable export.
  • Offline capture.
